findings.title: Call to non-existent no-arg isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but the only method defined in the parent UsernamePasswordForm is `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`. Unless a no-arg overload exists elsewhere, this does not compile. If an overload is intended, add it explicitly; otherwise pass `context.getUser()` (though note that would make the condition always false here since the branch only runs when user != null).

findings.title: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled requires non-null user, disabling passkeys on the initial login form
findings.body: `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)` returns true only when `user != null`. In `authenticate()` the webauthn form data is now filled only if this returns true, so for a normal (non re-authentication) login where `context.getUser() == null`, `webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context)` is never invoked and the conditional-UI/passkeys attributes are absent from the login page. Previously fillContextForm was called exactly in the user==null path. This breaks passwordless/conditional passkey login on the first login screen (and contradicts the tests asserting the `webauth` form is present on the initial login page). The same inverted condition also affects the error challenge path at line 137.

findings.title: Missing @Override on shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators
findings.body: `shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators(AuthenticationFlowContext)` overrides the newly added hook in WebAuthnAuthenticator but lacks the @Override annotation, so a future signature change in the base class would silently stop overriding and re-enable showing authenticators during conditional passkey login.
